Plot a PCA of samples

Source: R/qc.R
qc_plot_pca.Rd

Principal component analysis of log2(CPM + 1) of targeting sgRNAs (see qc_log2cpm); sgRNAs without variance are removed. Replicates should cluster together.

Usage

qc_plot_pca(
  counts,
  meta,
  ctrl_pattern = "NEG_CTRL",
  colour_by = "group",
  colours = NULL,
  shape_by = NULL,
  n_top = NULL,
  pcs = c(1, 2),
  label_points = TRUE,
  interactive = TRUE,
  base_size = 12
)

Arguments

counts

Count matrix: data frame with columns sgRNA, Gene and one column of raw counts per sample (see section 'Count matrix').

meta

Sample table: data frame with one row per sample and columns sample_id, label, group and replicate (see section 'Sample table'). Only samples in meta are used.

ctrl_pattern

Regular expression matched against the Gene column to identify control sgRNAs (default is "NEG_CTRL", which matches the controls of all libraries shipped with crisprFlow).

colour_by

Name of the column in meta used to colour samples.

colours

Optional named character vector of colours, with names matching the values of the colour_by column (e.g. c(Untreated = "#0073C2", Drug = "#CD534C")). If NULL (default), the RColorBrewer "Dark2" palette is used.

shape_by

Optional name of a column in meta used for point shapes (default is NULL).

n_top

Optional number of most variable sgRNAs to use (default is NULL, all sgRNAs).

pcs

The two principal components to plot (default is c(1, 2)).

label_points

Logical; label points with meta$label (default is TRUE; static plots only - interactive plots show labels on hover).

interactive

Logical; if TRUE (default), return an interactive plotly object, otherwise a ggplot object.

base_size

Base font size of the plot (default is 12).

Value

A plotly object (interactive = TRUE) or a ggplot object.

Examples

qc_plot_pca(exampleCounts, exampleSampleMeta, interactive = FALSE)
